gpt2Layers.source: GPT-2 small configuration: n_layer 12, n_head 12, n_embd 768 (64 per head), n_ctx 1024 (Radford et al. 2019; openai-community/gpt2 config.json)

gpt2Heads.unit: attention heads per layer of GPT-2 small

gpt2DHead.unit: numbers per head of GPT-2 small (768 / 12)

llamaLayers.source: Llama 2 7B: 32 layers, 32 attention heads (each with its own keys and values), model width 4096 (128 per head), context 4096 tokens (Touvron et al. 2023, Llama 2; meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf config.json)

llamaHeads.unit: key-value heads per layer of Llama 2 7B

halfBytes.unit: bytes per number in fp16 or bf16, the usual cache format of large models
halfBytes.source: IEEE 754 half precision and bfloat16 are 16-bit formats
